village275-final-credential-scope-axis-c.text:
# Independent review: collective credential scopes

Reviewed exact clean `932f38f6bc0f98268b22ed6c98f8a33fe64b7614`, range `3d4a4e74034bc523b4cabd35631e995113052bcc..932f38f6bc0f98268b22ed6c98f8a33fe64b7614`.

## Result

No blocker, important or minor findings. The common three-page CI render-global lint failure is addressed in production, without a helper mutation or lint exemption.

## Evidence

- Per-binding useId supplies an opaque mount namespace; a local numeric epoch changes immediately for a different viewer or credential. Conditional own-component state replacement uses a pure equality closure and produces a stable next render, avoiding effect-delayed cache scopes. This follows React's documented guarded current-component state adjustment pattern: https://react.dev/reference/react/useState#storing-information-from-previous-renders.
- Raw credential strings remain only in ephemeral equality/current closures; keys contain viewer plus opaque namespace/epoch. No raw credential field, effect dependency, persisted cache data or module-global mutation was introduced.
- Existing before-dispatch and after-response identity/credential checks, signals, pagination placeholder scope and mutation invalidation prefixes are unchanged. Prefix invalidation still covers every new scope. Separate bindings intentionally coalesce less cache; that tradeoff is explicitly recorded.
- Strict YAML required-name-to-timing obligations execute the actual production group route and REST adapter. Warm auth cache ensures both compared mounts start with the same epoch; the same QueryClient retains the older private response, the replacement read is held, and mounted DOM must exclude that response before release. Both changed-credential and same-credential remounts assert a different observed key and the actual new response.
- Inspected the remove-namespace mutation log: both named warmed remount cases fail at the actual leaked `initial-private` DOM assertion, not a private helper shape. Correct source restored and committed. The existing dispatch/late-response fixtures retain their actual HTTP/cache assertions.
- Inspected provided focused 4-pass, full 606-pass/3-known-skip plus 18 standard mutations, typecheck and lint logs. Lint has zero errors and seven inherited warnings. No redundant heavy test run was started by this reviewer.

Current descendant rebases, normal builds, fresh served provenance and CI are separate owner/root gates before updating publication metadata.
